definitions: If one is ever asked or required to do something, especially in a formal or official capacity.
In the event that one's services, help, or participation are requested or needed.
examples: She was ready to assist, if ever called upon to.
He kept his skills sharp, if ever called upon to.
The reserves were prepared, if ever called upon to.
I will testify, if ever called upon to.
They promised support, if ever called upon to.
